details.description: No top-level README.md explaining how to set up and use the project.
details.why_required: Developers need basic instructions to run the project and understand available tasks.
details.code_evidence: Repository contains JavaScript source but no README.md; see files: src/input.js, src/taskRunner.js, src/tasks.js.

details.description: `package.json` defines `start` -> `node src/index.js` but `src/index.js` is not present.
details.why_required: Running `npm start` will fail; developers must know the correct way to start the project.
details.code_evidence: package.json: "start": "node src/index.js"; actual files: src/input.js (CLI entry).

details.description: No documentation for how to invoke tasks, required CLI argument, and error behavior.
details.why_required: `src/input.js` requires a task name and throws if missing; `taskRunner` throws on unknown tasks — developers must know invocation details to use the tool.
details.code_evidence: src/input.js: throws `Task name is required` if no arg; src/taskRunner.js: throws `Unknown task: ${name}` for unknown tasks.

details.description: No guidance about testing; the `test` task exists but only logs a message.
details.why_required: Developers may assume `test` runs a test suite; documentation must clarify current behavior and next steps for adding tests.
details.code_evidence: src/tasks.js: test() { console.log("Running tests..."); } — no test runner or test files present.

details.description: No short explanation of how modules interact (input → taskRunner → tasks).
details.why_required: Helps new contributors quickly understand where to add tasks or integrate the runner.
details.code_evidence: src/input.js imports runTask from src/taskRunner.js, which in turn imports src/tasks.js.
